in-news.description: Consolidation of news articles featuring me, though they are all old.
in-news._why: The opening line is only the label "Styletag Related:", which makes a useless homepage excerpt. This sentence is the author's own, from later in the same post.

idea-go-back-in-time-with-your-friends-b.description: When I make new friends, I always wondered how many times we must have passed by each other, living in the same city, travelling in same bus.
remove: I learned that [låna pengar](www.låna-pengar.biz) means to borrow money there, and got robbed in Sweden on traveling excursion once, rather an useful quote if you are stuck in the same situation.
idea-go-back-in-time-with-your-friends-b._why: Injected SEO spam (Swedish payday-loan link) carried over from the old WordPress blog; removed at the author's request. The link also lacked a URL scheme, so it would have rendered as a broken relative link.
